1.title: Senate Judiciary Democrats
1.description: Defending freedoms. Advancing equality. Ensuring justice for all. News from the U.S. Senate Judiciary Committee Democrats, led by Ranking Member Dick Durbin (D-IL).

1.title: Trump Judicial Nominee Wrote “Any Republican Is Better Than Any Democrat”
1.description: Sen. DURBIN: Justice Gregory Cook described identified himself as "Trump-Tough" and wrote, “Any Republican is better than any Democrat." Litigants who have different political views than Justice Cook have no reason to believe he will treat them fairly.

2.title: Flock Cameras Risk Undermining Reproductive Care
2.description:
Sen. BOOKER: Could Flock be used to track and ultimately prosecute women who are accessing reproductive care?

Privacy expert: That is completely correct. The AI will find Planned Parenthood clinics. They will look for patterns—who went to a doctor and then to a drugstore.

3.title: How Loopholes Allow Flock To Share Data With ICE
3.description:
Sen. PADILLA: Can you explain how [Flock] agreements allow ICE to access data?

Privacy expert: All it takes is one officer who is a customer of Flock and participates in their data sharing program. [They] get a call from an ICE agent that says, "Hey, can you run a search for me?”

4.title: Republicans Refuse To Focus On Real Issues In Women’s Sports
4.description: Sen. DURBIN: If Republicans actually want to stand up for women in sports, they should address the real documented threats. Namely, unequal pay, failure to uphold title IX, rampant sexual abuse, and lack of equal resources for men's and women's teams.

5.title: Renée Good Should Still be Alive
5.description: Mother of Renée Good: Renée should still be alive. I’ll say that again: My daughter should still be alive.

6.title: Sheriff Explains Why He Stopped Using Flock
6.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Sheriff, what was the breaking point for you?

Sheriff who ended county Flock contract: They [Flock] would not give me answers. There was too much disinformation and dishonesty.

7.title: Mother Of U.S. Citizen Shot By ICE Shares Her Story
7.description: Mother of ICE shooting victim: Ruben was a loving brother, uncle, nephew and friend. He had no criminal history. The months that followed his shooting were consumed by grief and frustration. We felt unheard, left without answers—knowing Ruben's death was unjust.

8.title: Flock Leaders Refuse To Appear Before Judiciary Subcommittee
8.description: Sen. DURBIN: For the Flock CEO, obviously they are nervous about being on camera. But, I wish they would have joined us today. It would be interesting to hear their explanation.

9.title: DHS Refuses to Hold ICE Agents Accountable
9.description: Sons of father shot by ICE: We still haven’t gotten straight answers from DHS about what happened. What are the names of the ICE agents who killed our dad, Lorenzo Salgado Araujo? Why do they get to be protected behind anonymity?

10.title: Durbin Slams Republicans’ Sham Committee Hearing
10.description: Sen. DURBIN: If you ask the American people what issues they hope Congress will address, this hearing would not be in the top 10. People are concerned about the cost of living. They are concerned about their utility and grocery bills. They want to know what we are doing about it.

11.title: Republicans Didn’t Vote for Trump’s Immigration Terror Campaign
11.description: Mother of Renée Good: I voted for Trump under the impression that these agents were here to protect the citizens of the United States against terrorists…certainly not to accuse those of us here of being terrorists and take precious lives. This is madness.

12.title: Trump Nominee Pressed On Anti-Abortion Views
12.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Judge Pemberton, you found the decision by the Oklahoma Supreme Court preserving a right to an abortion when a mother’s life is at risk to be remarkably troubling. Is that your view today?
 
Trump Nominee: I was addressing the reasoning included in the Supreme Court's opinion.

13.title: How Overturning Roe V. Wade Was Judicial Activism
13.description:
Sen. SCHIFF: If a judge overturned decades of precedent because of their personal views, is that judicial activism?
 
Trump Judicial Pick: Yes.
 
Sen. SCHIFF: So, when SCOTUS overturned decades of precedent to reverse Roe V. Wade, wasn’t that judicial activism?
 
Trump Pick: *dodges*

14.title: Sen. Durbin Sounds Alarm On Trump DOJ Election Interference
14.description: Sen. DURBIN: With midterms fast approaching, the Trump Admin is using DOJ’s vast resources to politicize that agency and interfere with the election. President Trump and AG Blanche have turned to intimidating state election officials and voters, even at polling places.

15.title: Not A Single Agent Assigned To Work On Mar-a-Lago Case Still At FBI
15.description:
Sen. SCHIFF: Was Todd Blanche truthful when he said there is not a single agent still employed by the FBI who worked on the Mar-a-Lago investigation?

Patel: I believe his statement.

16.title: Even Republicans Can't Believe Kash Patel's FBI Hiring Changes
16.description: Even Senate Republicans are shocked that Kash Patel lowered FBI hiring standards to allow those with a history of stealing from an employer, paying for sex, or bestiality to work at the FBI.

17.title: Kash Patel's FBI Can Now Hire Applicants With History Of Bestiality
17.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Do you believe those who have stolen from employers, solicited sex, or engaged in bestiality are qualified candidates the FBI is losing?

Patel: They still have to go through the same rigorous application process.

18.title: Patel Uses FBI Resources To Investigate Critical Journalists
18.description:
Sen. BOOKER: After the New York Times reported that you used full-time FBI SWAT detail to drive your girlfriend, your agents interviewed your girlfriend about this reporting. Is that true?
 
Patel: We’re not going to participate. 

Sen. BOOKER: I’m asking yes or no questions.

19.title: Patel Refuses To Denounce Trump's Election Conspiracies
19.description:
Sen. WELCH: President Trump said, “The only way Democrats can get elected is to cheat.” Do you agree with the President?
 
Patel: I will not comment.

20.title: America Needs An FBI Director That Gives Us Answers Not Rhetoric
20.description: Sen. HIRONO: The FBI is supposed to investigate blatant public corruption, not turn a blind eye. This country needs an FBI director who will give us straight answers, not the kind of rhetoric that Kash Patel provided today.

21.title: Patel Leaves Open The Possibility Of Deploying FBI Agents To The Polls
21.description:
Sen. BLUMENTHAL: Can you commit that you will not send FBI agents to the polls?
 
Patel: The FBI will follow the law. I don't know that we cannot legally do it.
 
Sen. BLUMENTHAL: I am dissatisfied that you are unable to unequivocally commit that the FBI will be kept out of election interference.

22.title: Durbin Presses Patel For Justice For Victims Of Epstein
22.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Do you believe the Epstein files contain no meaningful evidence of wrongdoing by those not charged?
 
Patel: This Admin released 3.5 million pages of files.
 
Sen. DURBIN: You missed one important point. Congress had to pass a law requiring the Admin to disclose these files.

23.title: Durbin Calls Out Kash Patel’s Lies About CBP Shooting Victim
23.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Do you stand behind the false statements you made after Marimar Martinez was shot?
 
Patel: They weren’t false.
 
Sen. DURBIN: She was shot five times by federal agents. Your fear to investigate this shooting gives a blank slate to these agents.

24.title: Kash Patel Is The Least Qualified FBI Director In Our Nation’s History
24.description: Sen. DURBIN: Kash Patel is the least qualified and most partisan FBI Director in our nation’s history.

25.title: Even Pam Bondi Put The Blame On Todd Blanche
25.description: Sen. WHITEHOUSE: Things even Republicans purported to care about are disasters with Todd Blanche. Pam Bondi put the blame directly on him for the Justice Department’s Epstein Files foul-up. It was deadly serious for the victims. Complete disruption.

26.title: Every One Of These Nominations Is A Capitulation
26.description: Sen. WELCH: Is there no line that the Senate won’t allow Donald Trump to cross? It confirmed Bondi, Hegseth, Patel, Noem. And it’s about to confirm Blanche. The President is abusing his authority every day and every way, and that’s shame on him. But the Senate is failing to use its power.

27.title: Trump Loyalty Is Literally On The Justice Department
27.description: Sen. VAN HOLLEN: The Attorney General is supposed to be the people’s lawyer. But in the Trump Administration, DOJ is focused solely on pleasing one person. Lest anybody forget, huge banners with the President’s face hang outside DOJ. Todd Blanche walks under them every day.

28.title: Todd Blanche Will Forever Be Trump's Lawyer
28.description: Sen. BLUMENTHAL: ‘I’m his lawyer’ is what Todd Blanche said in his confirmation hearing. He had no intention of saying it, but he let it slip. And it was a glaring illustration of his mindset. He was, is now, and will forever be Donald Trump’s personal lawyer.

29.title: The True Story Of The Blanche MAGA Slush Fund
29.description: Sen. DURBIN: Donald Trump and Todd Blanche believe insurrectionists should receive not only a pardon, but financial compensation. Even Republicans had a bad reaction. Negotiations continued, but their so-called agreement wouldn’t pass law school Contracts 101.

30.title: Todd Blanche Just Can't STOP Being Trump's Lawyer
30.description: Sen. SCHIFF: The fundamental problem with Todd Blanche isn’t that he’s inexperienced or not intelligent. The problem with Todd Blanche is that he’s never been able to shed his role as criminal defense lawyer for Donald Trump. He just can’t do it.

31.title: Senate Republicans CAPITULATE By Confirming Todd Blanche
31.description: Sen. WELCH: The President is abusing his authority. The Senate is failing to use our authority. We can stop capitulating today by doing our job and rejecting a completely unqualified man to be the top law enforcement official in this country. I will vote no on Todd Blanche.

32.title: Todd Blanche's First Words are "I'm Trump's Lawyer"
32.description: Sen. PADILLA: Todd Blanche was asked if he and Trump were friends. He said ‘I’m his lawyer.’ That’s a remarkable slip. The first words out of his mouth when asked that question were ‘I’m his lawyer.’ The Attorney General isn’t supposed to be the President’s lawyer.

33.title: Sen. Booker UNLEASHES on Republicans Voting for Todd Blanche
33.description: Sen. BOOKER: Here’s the thing. You even have conservatives coming out saying this deal isn’t worth the paper its drawn on. This is all hat, no cattle. Where’s the beef? This is ridiculous. We got no guarantees this slush fund can’t go forward.

34.title: This DOJ is Basically the Department of RETRIBUTION and REVENGE
34.description: Sen. HIRONO: I can’t vote in favor of someone whose actions so clearly show he’s ineligible to serve even a department as compromised as this Department of Justice, which is basically a Department of Retribution and Revenge.

35.title: Todd Blanche is Trying to Protect Trump's FEELINGS
35.description: Sen. BLUMENTHAL: Todd Blanche claims to stand for law enforcement, but he supports an insurrectionist slush fund. His rehearsed lines are meant to protect Donald Trump’s feelings. That’s the through line—he’s the President’s lawyer.

36.title: Todd Blanche PROVED He Won't Stand Up to Trump
36.description: Sen. COONS: Since Watergate, both parties have recognized the importance of an Attorney General who will stand up to the President and say ‘no.’ Will Todd Blanche meet that standard? We have clear evidence he won’t. You can take it from his words to this committee.

37.title: Blanche DOJ Tried to COERCE Minnesota When Alex Pretti was Killed
37.description: Sen. KLOBUCHAR: I have great concerns about Todd Blanche’s willingness to uphold DOJ independence. Under Blanche, the Justice Department's tried to coerce states, including Minnesota on the day Alex Pretti was killed, to turn over voter data. They tried to tie it to ICE presence.

38.title: A Todd Blanche Vote is a Blessing for the Epstein COVER UP
38.description: Sen. WHITEHOUSE: Voting for this guy Todd Blanche today gives Republicans’ blessing to the botched Epstein Files release. Even Pam Bondi pointed at Blanche as responsible. It gives their blessing to his continuing role in the coverup.

39.title: Todd Blanche Vote is about Rule of Law vs. LAWLESSNESS
39.description: Sen. DURBIN: This isn’t Democrats vs. Republicans. This is rule of law vs. lawlessness. The Attorney General is the people’s lawyer. Todd Blanche continues to act as Donald Trump’s personal lawyer, treating the Justice Department like a law firm serving one client—the President.

40.title: ICE Detention Facilities are WAY Overcrowded
40.description:
Sen. PADILLA: As a medical professional, what’s your assessment of ICE’s ability to meet current needs?
 
Medical expert: The highest rates of death are in the most overcrowded facilities. There’s too many people and too few staff.

41.title: Former ICE Detainee After Release: "God Is Good"
41.description:
Sen. BLUMENTHAL: How’d it feel to be detained for two months while you were in high school?

Former ICE detainee: It was really bad. It’s hard to think about my mom, what she’s feeling, and what she’s seen. But God is good, and he helped us.

42.title: Former ICE Detainee: "They're Going for Everybody."
42.description:
Sen. BOOKER: Do you have any idea why ICE targeted you?

Former ICE detainee: I don’t. They’re going for everybody, no matter what age.

Booker: Si, la Verdad. Quiero dar gracias a usted. Tu tiene increíble coraje y tu es una persona muy impresionante.

Detainee: Gracias.

43.title: ICE Horror Stories Are More Common Than We See
43.description:
Sen. SMITH: A Minnesotan has been held in detention since December. She’s here legally and literally wasting away, but unable to get the medical care or legal advice they need. Does this sound familiar?
 
Medical expert: It’s not uncommon.
 
Former official: And it’s exacerbated.

44.title: Immigration Attorney Represented 500+ ICE Detainees
44.description: Immigration attorney: We’ve represented people detained in 18 states. Daily, we are forced to witness the abuse of power endemic to ICE’s mass detention campaign. We’ve represented 500+ people trapped in detention. Every single one of them has a story to share.

45.title: Former Government Official SPEAKS OUT On ICE Detention
45.description: Former government official: This is a moral question. A father was told his daughter would be taken from him. People are dying in our government’s custody with no one watching, no one accountable. This is not the United States that we were raised to believe in.

46.title: ICE Detention Conditions Have NEVER Been This Bad
46.description: Medical expert: For over two decades, I’ve been evaluating health care in immigration detention. I’ve sat with women and men after they were deported. Throughout, I’ve had deep concerns about the quality of medical care, but I’ve never been more alarmed than I am right now.

47.title: Former ICE Detainee Speaks Out PUBLICLY
47.description: Former ICE detainee: I thank God for bringing me and my family back together. My release is not easy. I’m forced to wear a GPS. I have to take a picture of myself every day. I’m always being watched. No one should ever go through this, especially someone my age.

48.title: ICE Uses Its Funding to Deprieve and Harm the Vulnerable
48.description: Sen. DURBIN: 50+ people have died in immigration detention under Trump. That’s more than double the full previous Administration. How’s this even possible? ICE is clearly not using resources to provide adequate medical care or improve conditions—so what are tax dollars going to?

49.title: Todd Blanche is Openly Colluding with the White House on Epstein
49.description: Sen. DURBIN: I remember Republicans claiming a chance meeting on the tarmac between Bill Clinton and Loretta Lynch was ‘collusion.’ But they express no concern JD Vance is leading sessions with Todd Blanche and Kash Patel to protect Donald Trump from the Epstein scandal.

50.title: Schiff SLAMS Blanche for Going After Trump's Enemies
50.description:
Sen. SCHIFF: Is it appropriate for a president to call on the Attorney General to prosecute enemies?
 
Former Republican attorney general: He is in charge of enforcing the law.
 
Schiff: You don’t seem to have a problem with that, do you?
 
AG: That includes his enemies.

51.title: Todd Blanche Treatment of Ghislaine Maxwell Violates DOJ's Own Rules
51.description:
Sen. BOOKER: Todd Blanche met with Ghislaine Maxwell and she was transferred to minimum security. Does that happen?
 
Former DOJ pardon attorney: It’d be a violation of DOJ’s own rules.
 
Booker: How do you feel?
 
Epstein survivor: It’s devastating for survivors.
 
Booker: It’s insulting.

52.title: Republican Senator Tillis Indicates He'll Withhold Vote Until Blanche Meets with Epstein Survivors
52.description: Sen. TILLIS: I have not made a final decision. Todd Blanche said he’d meet with the Epstein survivors if it could be arranged. I expect that meeting to occur before I’m willing to vote him out of committee. There should be no reason why he wouldn’t.

53.title: Todd Blanche Cares More About Reputation than Meeting with Epstein Survivors
53.description:
Epstein survivor: We talk about Todd Blanche’s credentials. As a career prosecutor, he should be salivating. This case is gold. 6 million files and thousands of victims.
 
Durbin: Why won’t he meet with you?
 
Survivor: Reputational harm.

54.title: Todd Blanche is Willing to Meet with Ghislaine Maxwell, but Not Survivors
54.description: Epstein survivor: Todd Blanche’s actions have destroyed survivors’ trust. He spent nine hours with Ghislaine Maxwell, but he didn’t spend even nine minutes meeting with a survivor.

55.title: DOJ Pardon Attorney Wrongfully Fired by Blanche Speaks Out
55.description: Former DOJ pardon attorney: I had great hope Todd Blanche would be a responsible steward of the Justice Department. He quickly proved me wrong. I declined to rubberstamp a political favor for a friend of Donald Trump, and it cost me my job.

56.title: Epstein Survivor Details Harm Caused by Todd Blanche's Justice Department
56.description: Epstein survivor: I found my name in two places in the first Epstein Files release. In the next release, the redactions were far worse. The Files displayed my name, phone number, and more. These documents contain disturbing yet incomplete accounts of my abuse. It was humiliating.

57.title: Todd Blanche Refusing to Meet with Epstein Survivors is Disqualifying
57.description: Sen. DURBIN: I will never forget Todd Blanche’s hearing yesterday. He was asked if he’d meet with Epstein’s victims. In my office, he said yes. In the hearing, he said no. I met with them. I’ll never forget it. No single member of the Senate should vote for him if they met with the survivors.

58.title: Senate Judiciary Democrats Offer Takeaways from Todd Blanche Hearing
58.description: Today’s hearing made it crystal clear: Todd Blanche is loyal to Donald Trump—not YOU. We’re live now detailing our opposition to his nomination to be Attorney General.

59.title: Brother of Epstein Victim Condemns Blanche's Inaction
59.description: Brother of Virginia Giuffre: Survivors deserve answers, not silence. If the goal is justice, if the goal is identifying everyone responsible for exploiting children, why wouldn't you do everything possible to help uncover the truth and hold every perpetrator accountable?

60.title: Epstein survivor: "Todd Blanche's silence is deafening."
60.description: Epstein survivor: We have asked to meet with Todd Blanche repeatedly, and we have never heard anything. That radio silence is deafening.

61.title: Epstein Survivor Urges Senators Tillis, Cornyn to Vote NO on Todd Blanche
61.description: Epstein survivor: We urge Senators Tillis and Cornyn to vote no on Todd Blanche’s nomination.

62.title: Todd Blanche Doesn't Know Who Wrote Trump Immunity Provision
62.description:
Sen. SCHIFF: Did you write the Trump immunity provision?

Blanche: No.

Schiff: But you put your name to it?

Blanche: I did.

Schiff: Who wrote this?

Blanche: DOJ. I don’t know the name.

Schiff: Who rejected the 25 defenses the IRS had?

Blanche: There was a lot of discussion.

63.title: Whitehouse Brings Receipts Of Judges Comments' On Blanche DOJ
63.description:
Sen. WHITEHOUSE: Here’s a word cloud of the commentary made by federal judges about your Justice Department. They’re red flag words. Can you say this misconduct will stop?
 
Blanche: *dodges*
 
Whitehouse: I will tell you that you are wrong.

64.title: Todd Blanche Defends Kash Patel's Drinking Habits
64.description:
Sen. WELCH: I have concerns about Kash Patel from reports about his drinking and bad morale at FBI. You are his supervisor.

Blanche: I don’t think he has any issues drinking.

65.title: ICE Shooting Victims Deserve Justice
65.description:
Sen. PADILLA: Is every life sacred?

Blanche: Yes.

Padilla: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, Johan Sebastián Guerrero were killed by ICE. Should state agencies be involved in investigations?

Blanche: Depends.

Padilla: Alex Pretti, Renee Good were also shot. There’s been no justice.

66.title: Todd Blanche Won't Meet with Epstein Survivors, But Did Meet with Ghislaine Maxwell
66.description:
Sen. BOOKER: Survivors of Epstein’s abuse reported crimes decades ago. You won’t meet with them, but you did meet with Ghislaine Maxwell. Did your interview with Maxwell lead to a single new person being charged?

Blanche: No.

Booker: A new investigation?

Blanche: *dodges*

67.title: Blanche Says that Trump is in Charge of the Justice Department
67.description:
Sen. HIRONO: Do you believe it’s the president’s right and duty to investigate perceived enemies?

Blanche: He is in charge of the Department of Justice.

Hirono: What he meant was pretty clear

68.title: Senator Coons: The January 6th Pardons are a "Slap in the Face" to Law Enforcement
68.description:
Sen. COONS: How many January 6th rioters were convicted of assaulting law enforcement officers?

Blanche: ~120.

Coons: 200+. How many had their sentences commuted or were pardoned?

Blanche: Every one.

Coons: The pardons are a shameful slap in the face to law enforcement.

69.title: Todd Blanche Affirms Trump's Pardons of Violent January 6th Rioters
69.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Donald Trump pardoned rioters who went on to commit serious crimes. Do you think the blanket pardons were appropriate?

Blanche: He has that power—I don’t question his authority or decision.

Durbin: You don’t question the decision?

Blanche: *dodges*

70.title: Todd Blanche Stands by Scandal-Ridden Kash Patel
70.description:
Sen. WHITEHOUSE: How long do you intend to put up with Kash Patel? Are you good with his airplane jaunts, confident he’s not drinking on the job, sure he knows what he’s doing?

Blanche: I have full faith in Director Patel.

Whitehouse: Great. You get to own that.

71.title: Sen. Klobuchar Presses Todd Blanche on Immigration Agent Abuses
71.description:
Sen. KLOBUCHAR: People want accountability for ICE shootings, even the non-death cases. Someone was picked out of his house in underwear in -10 degree weather without a warrant. Is that unacceptable?

Blanche: That depends on the circumstances.

72.title: Todd Blanche Admits He's DONALD TRUMP'S Lawyer
72.description:
Sen. KENNEDY: Are you and Donald Trump friends?
 
Blanche: I’m *his* lawyer.

73.title: Todd Blanche Refuses to Meet with Epstein Survivors
73.description:
Sen. DURBIN: There are ten Epstein survivors with us today, who have had no chance to speak with you. Will you meet with them?

Blanche: I have somebody from my office they can meet with.

Durbin: Will YOU meet with these survivors?

Blanche: *dodges*

74.title: Durbin Announces Opposition to Todd Blanche Attorney General Nomination
74.description: Sen. DURBIN: This nation deserves an Attorney General who loves the Constitution more than he loves the President. Mr. Blanche, you have proven beyond a reasonable doubt you are not that person.

75.title: Durbin Asks Supreme Court Justices About Security Threats
75.description:
Sen. DURBIN: What do courtrooms say about unmet security concerns?
 
Justice BARRETT: That’s part of their budget request. They’re in great need.
 
Justice KAGAN: Lower federal courts have some significant concerns.
 
Durbin: Very much so.

76.title: Durbin Slams AG Nominee Todd Blanche's Incendiary Comments About Federal Judges
76.description: Sen. DURBIN: Tomorrow we’re considering Todd Blanche’s nomination. He has said the courts are full of ‘rogue activist judges’ and the Trump Administration is ‘at war’ with the federal judiciary. That kind of rhetoric is unacceptable on either side of the table, Democratic or Republican.

77.title: Sen. Durbin Honors Sen. Graham at First Hearing Since Passing
77.description: Sen. DURBIN: I know this is a meeting of the Senate Judiciary Committee but something is missing. Lindsey Graham is missing. His absence is felt personally. Sending our condolences to his sister Darline, their family, friends in South Carolina and around the world. I’ll miss him.

78.title: Todd Blanche Never Stopped Being Trump's Attorney General
78.description: Sen. DURBIN: Next time we meet, we’ll consider Todd Blanche to be Attorney General. He’s Trump’s former personal lawyer and still plays that role. He has used DOJ to protect the President. He led the coverup of the Epstein files and established the slush fund for cop beaters.

79.title: Trump Judge Pick Slammed for Radical Anti-Immigrant Rulings
79.description:
Sen. DURBIN: You’ve embraced detaining any immigrant without bond, even though judges have ruled otherwise 14,000 times. How’re you neutral?

Trump nominee: There’s a wide range of opinion.

Durbin: You consistently rule against immigrants, even when not a danger to this country.

80.title: Trump Nominee Never Prepared to Address Denigrating Statements
80.description:
Sen. WHITEHOUSE: You have dozens of problematic tweets about elected officials, even members of this committee. You undertook no preparation to address questions on that?

Trump nominee: No.

Whitehouse: You didn’t tell DOJ?

Nominee: I tweet frequently.

81.title: Trump Nominee Pressed On Anti-Abortion Stance
81.description:
Sen. HIRONO: Do you remember filling out this candidate survey?
 
Trump nominee: Yes.
 
Hirono: You checked the box indicating you believe abortion isn’t acceptable and commented ‘strongly agree’ and that definitions should be ‘strictly defined’ to avoid loopholes.

82.title: Trump Judge Pick Grilled for Anti-LGBTQ+ Statement
82.description:
Sen. BLUMENTHAL: You agreed that marriage doesn’t include “anything but one man and one woman.”

Trump nominee: I did.

Blumenthal: This came five years after Obergefell.

83.title: Sen. Durbin Grills Nominee Who Called Police "Dumb As Dirt"
83.description:
Sen. DURBIN: You referred to police officers as ‘dumb as dirt.’ Now you’re seeking a position to work with police officers across the country?

Trump nominee: I routinely purge tweets.

Durbin: I can see why.

Nominee: I’m not familiar with the context.

Durbin: That’s it?

84.title: Mother Recounts Her Experience Under Texas's Abortion Ban
84.description: Abortion ban victim: Under Texas’s cruel abortion ban, I was forced to give birth to a baby every doctor knew would not survive. I was not allowed to make a decision. The state made it for me.

85.title: Abortion Bans Have Impacted Everyone In America
85.description:
Sen. MURRAY: Do you think any woman in this country can say the overturning of Roe v. Wade hasn't had an impact on them? 
 
Abortion ban victim: Every American has been impacted by these laws, whether they realize it or not.

86.title: Texas Abortion Ban Victim: "My Doctor Had Her Hands Tied By The State"
86.description: Abortion ban victim: My daughter was going to die. The only question was whether she was going to die inside of my body, putting my own life at risk. The one person I trusted with my life—my doctor—had her hands tied by the state. Helping me could have sent her to jail.

87.title: Women Are Losing Their Lives Because Of Abortion Bans
87.description: Planned Parenthood CEO: Bans don’t stop abortion. They only add burdens to those seeking them and to those providing them.

88.title: How Abortion Bans Silence Women And Doctors' Autonomy
88.description: Abortion ban victim: My baby was going to die, and my doctor couldn’t give me the dignity of explaining all of my options. We could talk about my right as a mother to not put my baby on life support after birth, but we couldn't talk about removing the only life support my baby had ever known. My body.

89.title: Election Expert Sounds Alarm On Trump's Election Lies
89.description: U.S. Elections Expert: The Administration has destroyed the trust that previously existed between many election officials and these federal agencies. None of this is helped by the deliberate spread of lies about our elections that we have heard from the President and many of his political allies.

90.title: Sen. Schumer Slams Trump Administration's Anti-Democratic Actions
90.description: Sen. SCHUMER: In America, voters pick their leaders, leaders don't pick their voters.

91.title: Election Expert: "DHS Is Confirming That Voter Fraud Is Extremely Rare"
91.description: U.S. Elections Expert: DHS is confirming what we've known for some time that voter fraud, and in particular non-citizen voting, is extremely rare. The President continues to push conspiracies about the 2020 election and spend vast federal resources to investigate a crime that was never committed.

92.title: Arizona Secretary of State Highlights Dangers of Trump Admin Election Interference
92.description: Arizona Secretary of State: It's not just foreign actors eroding public confidence in our [election] systems. It is still unclear how the Department of Homeland Security is going to determine citizenship of our voters, given their terrible data track record.

93.title: Trump Judge Pick Helped Greenlight Mass Deportations
93.description:
Sen. DURBIN: You embraced Trump’s position detaining any immigrant without a bond hearing. Why are you so extreme on detention?
 
Nominee: I felt the Administration was within its limits.

94.title: Trump Judicial Pick's Hypocrisy Exposed on Political Controversy
94.description:
Sen. SCHIFF: Who won the 2020 election?

Trump nominee: *dodges*

Schiff: You involved yourself in political controversy at Columbia, took it upon yourself to insert yourself. But you can’t answer who won the 2020 election? There’s no way to square those two things.

95.title: Trump Judge Pick Refuses to Say Capitol Attacked On January 6th
95.description:
Sen. BLUMENTHAL: Was the Capitol attacked on January 6th?
 
Trump nominee: It was troubling. I’m not going to characterize beyond that.
 
Blumenthal: You’ve seen video and know about injuries to officers. You can’t say it was attacked?
 
Nominee: *dodges*
 
Blumenthal: I’m astonished.

96.title: We Need Neutral Judges as Trump Violates Court Orders
96.description: Sen. DURBIN: Judges appointed by Republicans and Democrats have found that the Trump Administration broke the law. And violating a court order isn’t acceptable. Yet, that’s exactly what’s happening.

97.title: Trump Lied. Now, Stephen Miller Wants to Get Rid of Immigrants.
97.description: Sen. HIRONO: Donald Trump spent all of 2024 insisting he’d go after the ‘worst of the worst.’ And yet, like everything else, that was a lie. His regime has indiscriminately gone after all immigrants, swept up into Stephen Miller’s desire to get rid of immigrants in our country.

98.title: Trump Has a Radical Goal: Mass Deportation
98.description: Sen. WELCH: The Trump Administration has a very radical goal: mass deportation. Dreamers, DACA recipients, and folks here legally. I oppose that. They’re willing to go to abusive lengths. The cruelty creates fear and anxiety in targeting legal immigrants.

99.title: Sen. Durbin: "I'm Proud to Be the Son of an Immigrant"
99.description: Sen. DURBIN: My mom’s naturalization certificate is displayed behind my desk. She came to the United States at age two. She handed it to me before she passed away. I’m proud that I’m the son of an immigrant. The thought of taking something so precious away from her because of ‘political views’ doesn’t sound like the America she was trying to be a part of.

100.title: Republicans Pushing to Confirm Judge Who Never Tried a Case
100.description: Sen. DURBIN: There are 3,000+ licensed attorneys in Montana. You’d think the White House would find one with experience. Instead, Trump picked Katie Lane. She isn’t remotely qualified. That isn’t my opinion—that’s her official rating from the American Bar Association.

101.title: Trump Nominee Deems $400K Owed By Trump a "Small Amount"
101.description:
Sen. BOOKER: Shouldn’t we ask what your financial tie is to Trump?

Trump nominee: My firm has revenues of almost $2 billion. It’s a small amount.

Booker: To you. To the average American, it’s $400,000. This is a president with personal lawyers all over his administration.

102.title: Trump Nominee Tries Dodging Election Denial Brief He Signed
102.description:
Sen. KLOBUCHAR: Do you agree with a judge’s ruling that the Constitution doesn’t grant the President any specific powers over elections?
 
Trump nominee: I can’t comment.
 
Klobuchar: You signed this brief.

103.title: Sen. Booker Pushes Judicial Nominee on Trump Financial Ties
103.description:
Sen. BOOKER: Why not disclose Trump’s financial obligations to you?
 
Trump nominee: That money goes to my firm.
 
Booker: Aren’t you compensated?
 
Nominee: Yes.
 
Booker: You’re saying we shouldn’t know about any obligations Donald Trump has to your firm?

104.title: Judicial Nominee Breaks from Trump, Promising Recusal
104.description:
Sen. DURBIN: You’re currently serving as Trump’s personal attorney?

Nominee: Yes.

Durbin: You’re the third personal attorney to nominated. Why should we trust you?

Nominee: *dodges*

Durbin: Will you recuse yourself from Trump cases?

Nominee, in break from Trump (!!!): Yes.

105.title: Sen. Welch Calls for Mid-Decade Redistricting, Gerrymandering Bans
105.description: Sen. WELCH: It’s time to ban partisan gerrymandering, and it’s time to ban mid-decennial redistricting.

106.title: Trump's MAGA Slush Fund Rewards Violent Criminals
106.description: Sen. DURBIN: How much is it worth to be on Donald Trump’s good side? His new MAGA slush fund is $1.8 billion. Lawyers for the January 6th insurrectionists pardoned by Trump already say they’ll apply for compensation.

107.title: Election Denying Nominees: What the Hell Good are You?
107.description: Sen. DURBIN: We ask all these nominees what happened on January 6th, and they say it was sunny and the wind was blowing. No, there was a mob that attacked the Capitol. If you can’t acknowledge that, then what the hell good are you?

108.title: Republicans Are Advancing Bad Nominees During Police Week
108.description: Sen. DURBIN: Senate Republicans are pushing ~50 nominees on a partisan fast track process. Several unqualified January 6th apologists, brought to us by a President who pardoned violent rioters. Supporting nominees like this is no way to back the blue.

109.title: Survivor Parents Stand Up to Big Tech in Senate Hearing
109.description:
Sen. COONS: Could you please raise up the photos of your kids, who were victims of Big Tech?

Survivor parents: *raise photos*

Coons: Look at those faces. That’s the reminder of why we’re here.

110.title: Snapchat Connected Her Son to Dealer Who Poisoned Him
110.description: Survivor parent: My son died from fentanyl poisoning after Snapchat connected him with a dealer. He was 19. Snapchat connected him with a local dealer selling counterfeit pills. One pill ended his life while Snapchat let the dealer continue selling to children long after he died.

111.title: Attorney Who Beat Meta Recounts Zuckerberg in Court
111.description:
Sen. BLUMENTHAL: You had Zuckerberg on the stand.

Attorney: Yes.

Blumenthal: He denied Instagram’s addictive?

Attorney: Yes.

Blumenthal: You showed internal documents that he’s lying?

Attorney: The amount of dancing done you would’ve thought Zuckerberg’s a ballroom dancer.

112.title: Attorney Who Beat Meta Details Tech's Parent Blaming
112.description:
Sen. KLOBUCHAR: What were the biggest challenges you faced in the landmark case with Meta?

Attorney: The company wanted to target the children and families in the courtroom, say it wasn’t Meta’s fault, and blame parents. Even though the mom in our case did everything she could

113.title: Survivor Parent Says It's Time to Shift Blame from Parents to Tech
113.description: Survivor parent: Comments are made that it’s parents’ responsibility to protect children online. Even the best parenting skills can’t fight these algorithms. I was the engaged parent, yet this harmful content still found its way into my son’s phone. Parents can’t fight this alone.

114.title: Attorney Who Beat Meta Speaks Out on Horrifying Evidence
114.description: Attorney: I’m a trial lawyer. I tried the case against Meta and Google in Los Angeles, the first social media addiction case decided by an American jury. The evidence that I saw in that case keeps me up at night.

115.title: Sen. Durbin Says it's Time to Repeal Big Tech Legal Immunity
115.description: Sen. DURBIN: Two things we can do to stand up to Big Tech. Repeal Section 230. Let every American family access courts to enforce the protection of their children. We will see things happen dramatically if we do those two things.

116.title: Sen. Klobuchar on Historic Victories Against Big Tech
116.description: Sen. KLOBUCHAR: A bellwether case in California found Meta and YouTube were negligent and liable. The state of New Mexico won its case against Meta. These courtroom victories are incredibly important, but they can’t be an excuse for complacency.

117.title: Sen. Durbin: Dream Act Becoming Law is "My Dream" Before Retiring
117.description: Sen. DURBIN: As I retire from Congress, my dream is the Dream Act to become law before I go. My colleagues feel as strongly as I do about this issue, and they’ll continue to fight. I’m not going to give up on you. Don’t give up on me. Justice will prevail—the sooner the better.

118.title: Sen. Whitehouse to Police Chief Defending DACA: "God Bless You"
118.description: Sen. WHITEHOUSE: What passes for ‘law enforcement’ by these so-called immigration agents simply doesn’t qualify as law enforcement. It’s embarrassing to the profession to see people with badges behaving that way. Then there you are, Chief, picking up the pieces. God bless you.

119.title: Police Chief to Booker: We'd Be "Less Safe" Without DACA
119.description:
Sen. BOOKER: DACA recipients are an add to America. If we got rid of DACA recipients like the Trump Administration wants, would we be less safe?

Police chief: Yes, we would.

Booker: Losing them would create an environment that our communities are less safe?

Chief: Correct.

120.title: Sen. Hirono: Trump is Destroying DACA By a Thousand Cuts
120.description:
Sen. HIRONO: Would you say the Trump regime is destroying DACA by a thousand cuts?
 
Immigration advocate: 1000%. It’s easier now to deport and detain DACA recipients, even if all of your paperwork is in place.

121.title: Police Chief: DACA Officers Serve Honorably, Build Trust
121.description: Police chief: I serve as the chief of police in the community I lived in fear in as a young undocumented immigrant. I see this issue through a human and public safety lens. Dreamers grow up here. DACA police officers serve us honorably, many are bilingual, and they build trust.

122.title: Immigration is Foundation to Our Economy, Business
122.description: Business leader: Our economy cannot thrive and our cost of living will not stabilize if we continue to break the very workforce that sustains it. We fully support the Durbin-Murkowski Dream Act to provide a path to citizenship for Dreamers.

123.title: How Trump is Dismantling DACA Bit by Bit
123.description: Immigration advocate: This Administration is ending DACA bit by bit, cut by cut. We’re here today because of the increased urgency of the moment.

124.title: Wife of Wrongly Detained DACA Recipient Speaks Out Publicly
124.description: Wife of wrongfully detained DACA recipient: We’re raising three children in Texas. He was driving to the hospital to deliver my breast milk for our baby in the NICU when a car full of ICE agents took him. Delays in renewal processing have now caused his status to lapse.

125.title: Wrongfully Deported DACA Recipient Speaks Out
125.description: Wrongfully deported DACA recipient: I’m a mother. I help homeless people find safe housing, meals, and support. Three months ago, the life I have built was in danger. I walked into a scheduled immigration appointment and was handcuffed, detained, and deported. All with DACA.

126.title: Sen. Padilla Calls Out Republicans Ignoring Threats to DACA
126.description: Sen. PADILLA: The Republican majority refuses to have a full formal committee hearing on the Trump Administration’s threats to DACA. They don’t want to hear the truth. But this is one of the tools we have to shed light on Dreamers.

127.title: Durbin Hosts Spotlight Forum on Protecting Dreamers
127.description:
The Trump Administration has launched an all-out assault on DACA. 

Slow-rolling renewals. 
Allowing work authorizations to expire. 
Stalling processing. 

Dreamers are in Congress now to hold truth to power. Watch.

128.title: Durbin Calls Out Trump Admin's DACA Delays
128.description: Sen. DURBIN: I’ve heard from constituents filing DACA renewals up to 150 days in advance of expiration—as recommended. They’re still losing protections because of Trump Administration delays. Now, those with active DACA status have dropped by 32,000.

129.title: Sen. Durbin Calls for Committee Action on DACA, Dream Act
129.description: Sen. DURBIN to Chairman GRASSLEY: We have the authority, the jurisdiction, and the responsibility to do something on immigration. I ask you to schedule a hearing on DACA and Dreamers, as well as a markup on the bipartisan Dream Act.

130.title: Senate Judiciary Republicans Approve Online Troll Trump Nominee
130.description: Sen. DURBIN: We’ve never had a nominee like Kara Westercamp. Her offensive social media posts demonstrates she lacks the temperament to serve. She spread conspiracy theories and attacked Republicans and Democrats on her since-deactivated Twitter account.

131.title: Sen. Durbin Decries Trump Judicial Pick Who Never Tried a Case
131.description: Sen. DURBIN: 3,603. That’s how many licensed attorneys are in Montana. Couldn’t the White House find an attorney who has actually tried a case? Katie Lane isn’t remotely qualified. That’s not my opinion alone—she’s the first Trump 2.0 judicial nominee to receive a Not Qualified rating from the ABA.

132.title: Sen. Durbin Recaps Pam Bondi's Disastrous Tenure
132.description: Sen. DURBIN: This is our first meeting since Trump fired Pam Bondi. She did more damage to the Justice Department’s reputation than any Attorney General in history. She transformed it into a weaponized political battleground. Courts and grand juries blocked her baseless prosecutions.

133.title: Sen. Whitehouse to GOP: "Don't Come Complaining to Me" as Winds Shift
133.description: Sen. WHITEHOUSE: If Republicans want to put U.S. Attorneys in without touching base with this committee or home state Senators, keep it up. But when the time comes and the winds shift, don’t come complaining to me.

134.title: Sen. Blumenthal Chides Trump Nominees for Election Denial
134.description: Sen. BLUMENTHAL: I’m appalled that nominees for a lifetime appointment to the federal bench are unwilling to respond on an issue of fact: if Joe Biden won the 2020 election. You’ve been rehearsed to provide a stock answer. It reflects on your honesty.

135.title: Trump Nominee Again Refuses to Admit Joe Biden Won in 2020
135.description:
Sen. BLUMENTHAL: Who won the 2020 election?

Trump nominee: I know this question has come up… Joe Biden was certified.

Blumenthal: He won?

Nominee: He was certified.

136.title: Trump Nominee Refuses to Disavow Extreme Gun Stances
136.description:
Sen. DURBIN: You joined a group calling for ATF to be ‘abolished’ and all gun laws ‘unconstitutional.’

Trump nominee: *persistent stumbling*

Durbin: Do you think all gun laws are unconstitutional?

Nominee: That’s a political question.

Durbin: You’re ducking.

137.title: Sen. Durbin Condemns Political Violence After WHCD Shooting
137.description: Sen. DURBIN: Whether right or left, political violence has no place in America. None. The shooting at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner shows a sobering pattern. These attacks have a chilling impact on politics.

138.title: Sen. Padilla Admonishes Election Lies Peddled by Republicans
138.description: Sen. PADILLA: Let me recognize the obvious. If the objective here is to get down to anything, we’d have Jack Smith before us. This is just another opportunity for those refusing to admit Donald Trump lost the 2020 election to air grievances and spread the Big Lie.

139.title: Sen. Durbin Calls Out Republicans Stalling Jack Smith Testimony
139.description: Sen. DURBIN: All these questions and charges about Jack Smith. Where’s Jack Smith? That tells the whole story.

140.title: Sen. Durbin Exposes Pardoned Trump Lackey as a Fraud
140.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Mr. Clark, you’ve invoked the 5th Amendment in the past. Like violent insurrectionists, you received an inappropriate but valid Trump pardon. You have no basis now.

Republican witness: I’ll invoke 4 privileges.

Durbin: Interesting. Even pardoned you won’t tell us.

141.title: Sen. Welch Presses Republican Election Denier
141.description:
Sen. WELCH: Who won the 2020 presidential election?
 
Republican witness: That’s a political question.
 
Welch: I’m asking who won.
 
Witness: I’m not a pollster.
 
Welch: I’m not asking about a pollster. I’m asking who won.

142.title: Sen. Durbin Admonishes Election Denier Republican Witness
142.description: Sen. DURBIN: It’s bad enough to watch Trump nominees embarrass themselves under oath. Any deviation from the Big Lie could be politically fatal. So they refuse to answer who won the 2020 presidential election. Now it’s Big Lie architect Jeffrey Clark front and center here.

143.title: Debunking Republican Myths re: the Jack Smith Investigation
143.description: Sen. WELCH: An investigation like this will never happen again, if we never have a President who calls for people to overthrow an election after he loses. The questions you laid out are normal investigatory steps.

144.title: Republicans are Targeting Voting Instead of Real Issues
144.description: Sen. DURBIN: This is all unnecessary and overdone. There are more important things to worry about than the SAVE America Act, like getting gas prices down or this President’s undeclared war.

145.title: Debunking Trump Lies About So-Called 'Rampant Voter Fraud'
145.description: Sen. DURBIN: In a 20 year period of time, think about all the possibilities of voter fraud. How many do you think? 7 million? No. 700,000? No. 70,000? No. 700? No. It’s 77 people in 20 years.

146.title: How Donald Trump's Voter Suppression Scares Will Fail
146.description: Sen. PADILLA: Donald Trump signed another unlawful executive order. This time targeting vote by mail. It’s absurd, unconstitutional, and it’s not going to work. Voters will not be silenced.

147.title: Sen. DURBIN Torches Trump's Mass Deportation and Corrupt Agenda
147.description: Sen. DURBIN: DOJ closed more than 23,000 criminal investigations, including into drug trafficking and terrorism, in the first six months of the Trump Administration. At the same time, the President pardoned wealthy allies who defrauded Americans and founded dark web drug markets.

148.title: How Trump's Politicization of DOJ Undermines National Security
148.description: Sen. DURBIN: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche recently announced that all employees at DOJ and FBI who worked on investigations into Donald Trump are gone. The Department also said it's facing unprecedented personnel constraints at a time when our country is at war with Iran.

149.title: Sen. DURBIN Slams Trump's Weaponization of the Department of Justice
149.description: Sen. DURBIN: Getting even with people is not the mission of the Department of Justice. DOJ’s mission is the administration of law in a nonpolitical way.

150.title: Sen. Schiff Pushes for Jack Smith Testimony, Vol. II Report Release
150.description: Sen. SCHIFF: I fully support bringing Jack Smith before this committee. I also support making sure we can ask the right questions and get full answers. Donald Trump brought documents to Mar-a-Lago so highly classified that only six people were authorized to see them.

151.title: Kash Patel Could Never Be a Qualified Director like Robert Mueller
151.description: Sen. DURBIN: With his contempt for Robert Mueller, it’s no surprise Donald Trump would pick Kash Patel. By any measure, Kash Patel doesn’t have the experience, judgment, or temperament of Robert Mueller. He has spent a year weaponizing the FBI to serve Donald Trump, and it makes us all less safe.

152.title: Sen. SCHIFF Presses Trump Nominee on Minimal Experience
152.description:
Sen. SCHIFF: Have you tried a case to verdict?

Trump nominee: I worked on a bench trial and handled seven as a clerk.

Schiff: The judge handles trials. Were you lead counsel?

Nom: No.

Schiff: Your trial experience is as second or third lawyer on one bench trial?

Nom: Yes.

153.title: Trump Judicial Nominee Refuses to Say Trump Lost 2020 Election
153.description:
Sen. BLUMENTHAL: Who won the 2020 election?

Trump nominee: *legal condescension*

Blumenthal: That’s not my question. Who won?

Nominee: *dodges*

154.title: Trump Nominee Refuses to Apologize to Law Enforcement Officers
154.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Will you apologize to law enforcement officers for spreading conspiracy theories about their role on January 6th?

Trump nominee: I regret retweeting posts from people I don’t know.

Durbin: We’re trying to see if you have the temperament for a lifetime appointment.

155.title: Sen. DURBIN: Trump Nominee's Social Media 'Reads Like Trump Fanfic'
155.description: Sen. DURBIN: This Trump nominee’s social media account reads like a Trump fan fiction. Questioning the outcome of the 2020 election. Whitewashing the January 6th insurrection. Attacking Chief Justice Roberts.

156.title: Sen. DURBIN Reacts to Historic Court Ruling Against Meta
156.description: Sen. DURBIN: Parents and grandparents are scared as hell by what social media platforms are pushing to kids. The New Mexico jury’s decision against Meta should be a call to action. The Senate should actually legislate for a change.

157.title: Sen. Hirono Lambasts Republican Conspiracy Theories, Stalling
157.description: Sen. HIRONO: Well, here we are once again… a hearing espousing Republican conspiracy theories on Jack Smith. How many times do we have to say to just bring Jack Smith in to testify under oath? Instead of speculations, just call him in.

158.title: Former FBI Special Agent: We Are 'Less Safe' With Kash Patel at FBI
158.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Generational damage has been done at FBI. What’s the future?

Former FBI special agent: FBI needs an unbiased leader with experience. I don’t see that in Kash Patel, and he lacks the character to carry out the duties. Our country is less safe.

Durbin: I agree.

159.title: Former FBI Special Agent Slams Kash Patel for FBI Mismanagement
159.description: Former FBI special agent: Kash Patel has pursued a campaign of retribution against his own personnel. Agents are removed not for misconduct, but for lawful participation in authorized investigations. His actions risk generational harm to an institution that protects our nation.

160.title: Sen. Durbin Calls Out Sham Republican Hearing Amid DOJ/FBI Chaos
160.description: Sen. DURBIN: Why are Republicans afraid to bring in Jack Smith? They’ve avoided it for six months, so they can continue these sham hearings. Meanwhile, the Trump Administration has dismantled the FBI and it makes us all less safe.

161.title: Sen. Whitehouse Spells Out Trump's Decimation of FBI, DOJ
161.description: Sen. WHITEHOUSE: Here’s what’s happened since Donald Trump took office. FBI lost 300+ agents. Disbanded foreign influence task force. 6000+ DOJ employees have left. Half of line prosecutors in counterterrorism section have left. It’s the same story throughout the Administration.

162.title: Sen. Durbin Admonishes Trump's Reaction to Robert Mueller's Passing
162.description: Sen. DURBIN: I never questioned Bob Mueller’s devotion to our nation or his integrity. How’d Trump respond to his passing? He said ‘Good. I’m glad he’s dead.’ Reprehensible. Unfortunately, Republicans are complicit in the attacks on Robert Mueller.

163.title: Sen. Whitehouse Defends Law Enforcement in Jack Smith Investigation
163.description: Sen. WHITEHOUSE: If you ask anyone with law enforcement experience to react to the FBI seeking these toll records, their response is ‘of course they did.’ Virtually every investigation involves subpoenas for toll records. Sometimes it’s to help understand the scope of a conspiracy.

164.title: Sen. Durbin Calls Out Trump's Performative 'Fraud Department'
164.description: Sen. DURBIN: The Trump Administration created the ‘fraud enforcement’ division out of thin air. The Justice Department already had offices to prosecute fraud. They systematically dismantled them. Meanwhile, Donald Trump is doubling his net worth and pardoning fraudsters.

165.title: Durbin Slams The Admin's Extreme Nominees Who Will Help President Trump Weaponize The Justice System

166.title: Teacher Reads Letter from Sixth Grader Impacted by ICE
166.description:
HEARTBREAKING. A schoolteacher just shared what one sixth grader wrote about what ICE is doing to her community.

“Where is the justice for all?”

💔

167.title: Sen. HIRONO Sums Up Democrats' DHS Funding Fght
167.description: Sen. HIRONO: I want to make it very plain. Senate Democrats support the funding of FEMA and TSA, but we don’t support funding ICE without guardrails to prevent lawlessness.

168.title: Somali American Teen Defies Trump's Demeaning Words
168.description:
Sen. DURBIN: You’re Somali?
 
Somali-American teenager: I am.
 
Durbin: The President spoke about “sh*thole” countries. What was your community’s reaction?
 
Teenager: I love my community because we fought back. At first, anger and hurt. Then, we advocated.

169.title: Immigration Attorney Shares Horrifying Stories with Congress
169.description:
Sen. BLUMENTHAL: What’re your reactions to the reports of children detained in Dilley?
 
Immigration law expert: It’s deplorable. Children don’t have access to clean drinking water, nutritious food, or medical care. They’ve found live worms in their food.

170.title: The Kids Are Not Alright: How Mass Deportation is Traumatizing Children
170.description:
MAGA’s mass deportation campaign is terrorizing communities—but especially kids.
 
We brought brave students and advocates to Capitol Hill to speak truth to power.
 
NO MORE anti-immigrant crusade. Watch.

171.title: Clinical Psychologist Shares Grave Harms to Kids Threatened by ICE
171.description: Clinical psychologist: The psychological burden created by uncertainty, family separation, and chronic fear profoundly shape children’s development. The effects of immigration enforcement ripple outward across families, classrooms, and entire communities.

172.title: Immigration Law Expert Highlights Child Trauma from ICE Agents
172.description: Immigration law expert: My youngest clients have been 1- and 2-year-olds. Children have been arrested and detained across the United States. From January to October 2025, 3800+ children were arrested by federal immigration authorities, including 20 infants. 1700+ were detained.

173.title: Minnesota Teenager Recounts Havoc Wreaked by ICE in the Twin Cities
173.description: Somali-American teenager: Alex Pretti, Renee Good, and Keith Porter were murdered at the hands of ICE agents, and the Trump Administration demonized them. People were deported, students were impacted. But it’s not criminals or terrorists. It’s people like me.

174.title: Teacher: '6-Year-Olds Were Asking Me What a Tear Gas Canister Does'
174.description: First grade teacher: As educators, we’re in the business of protecting our students. But we shouldn’t have to protect them from the federal government. Schools shouldn’t feel like war zones. Kids were asking me what tear gas does. Attendance dropped.

175.title: High School Senior Slams ICE's Terror Campaign
175.description: High school senior, advocate: I was in my fourth period class when I saw videos of ICE agents attacking people in Chicago. People were afraid to speak or leave their homes for months. School hallways were left empty. I’ve seen kids get thrown to the ground for just recording.

176.title: Sen. DURBIN: 'This is an Occupation by a Paramilitary Force'
176.description: Sen. DURBIN: This is not a public safety operation. It’s an occupation by a paramilitary force. And it is children who are the most harmed by this cruelty.

177.title: Durbin Delivers Statement In His Forum On Children Traumatized By The MAGA Mass Deportation Agenda

178.title: Sen. HIRONO Decries MAGA Attempt to Fully Rewrite 14th Amendment
178.description:
Sen. HIRONO: All of a sudden, opponents of the plain language of the 14th Amendment want to rewrite it. Is that necessary?

Law professor: They’d have to literally rewrite it. They’d have to add words which aren’t in there.

179.title: Sen. PADILLA Hushes MAGA Attempts to Halt Birthright Citizenship
179.description: Sen. PADILLA: Let me begin by quoting the Constitution. The 14th Amendment is pretty straightforward. If you were born on American soil, you are an American citizen. Full stop.

180.title: Law Professor Details Devastating Impacts of Proposed Trump Order
180.description:
Sen. WELCH: What would happen if Donald Trump’s unconstitutional birthright citizenship order went into effect?
 
Law professor: It’d deny citizenship to children of undocumented immigrants and even some green card applicants. Every family in the United States having a child would have to prove their status.

181.title: Immigrant Marine Proudly Defends Birthright Citizenship
181.description: Immigrant and veteran: My name is Alejandro Barranco. I am a United States citizen, I am a Marine. And I am an American because I was born here. I was raised to love this country. I grew up proud to be an American—and I still am.

182.title: Sen. DURBIN Cites Noem Firing as Call to End Mass Deportations
182.description: Sen. DURBIN: Kristi Noem sat at this table one week ago. She was removed as Secretary just 48 hours later. This is a national conversation about immigrants. Do we fear them? Or do we embrace them as part of America? I sure hope it’s the latter.

183.title: Sen. WELCH Uses Sham Republican Hearing to Call Out ICE Abuses
183.description: Sen. WELCH: People were shot down by ICE in Minneapolis in the name of so-called ‘enforcement’ of citizenship. Constitutional rights are being violated. This hearing has to be about ensuring and protecting constitutional rights.

184.title: Sen. DURBIN Refutes Republican Senator on 'Save America Act'
184.description:
Sen. CORNYN: I don’t get how the SAVE Act disenfranchises.

Sen. DURBIN: Happy to explain. Drivers licenses don’t work. 50% of Americans don’t have passports.

Cornyn: Amend it?

Durbin: When’s the last time the Senate amended a bill?

185.title: Sen. DURBIN Decries Trump Judicial Pick's Racist Commentary
185.description: Sen. DURBIN: This Trump nominee refused to disavow controversial commentary. He said it’s ‘essentially accurate’ that ‘you could abort every black baby in this country and your crime rate would go down.’ How can people of color have faith they’ll be treated fairly in his court?

186.title: Sen. DURBIN Decries Kristi Noem's Lacking "Common Decency"
186.description: Sen. DURBIN: The questions asked of Kristi Noem got to the heart of who she is. They were questions of common decency. She called victims who died ‘domestic terrorists.’ Imagine those families. But I know the phrase ‘I’m sorry’ is just unacceptable in the Trump Administration.

187.title: Sen. Schiff Calls Out Noem Lying Regarding Independent Investigations
187.description:
Sen. SCHIFF: Your agency pushes away independent investigators. How is the public supposed to believe anything your agency says or finds?

Noem: Investigations are being done the same.

Schiff: No, they’re not. You’re not allowing state and local investigators to participate.

188.title: Sen. Padilla Faces Noem After Removal From DHS Presser
188.description:
Sen. PADILLA: Secretary Noem, I’m Senator Alex Padilla, the senior Senator for the State of California.

(Senator Padilla was indefensibly wrestled to the ground at Noem’s press conference last June.)

189.title: Republican Senator To Kristi Noem: 'You Have Failed At FEMA'
189.description: Republican Senator to Noem: You have failed at FEMA. I have reason to believe you are violating the law.

190.title: Sen. Hirono Confronts Kristi Noem with DHS Brutality
190.description:
Sen. HIRONO: The man in this photo is surrounded by agents.
 
Noem: Yes.
 
Hirono: His arms were up in prayer. They shot him with pepper balls 7 times.
 
Hirono: Next photo. Do you see the woman on the ground?
 
Noem: Yes.
 
Hirono: This is just after your agent shoved her down to the ground in front of her children.

191.title: Republican Senator Calls Out Kristi Noem's Countless Mistakes
191.description: Republican Senator to Noem: When you make a mistake, correct it. Don’t walk away from it. You don’t take a puppy out to a hunting lodge and then decide to kill it. Those are bad decisions made in the heat of the moment, just like what happened in Minneapolis.

192.title: U.S. Citizens Detained by DHS Bravely Stand Up to Kristi Noem
192.description:
Sen. BLUMENTHAL: Have you met with any citizens arrested and detained by DHS?

Noem: *dodges*

Blumenthal: I’d like to introduce you to three individuals who were wrongfully arrested by your department.

Detained citizens: *stand*

Blumenthal: U.S. citizens shouldn't be arrested.

193.title: Kristi Noem Refuses to Rule Out Sending DHS to Polling Places
193.description:
Sen. COONS: Will you rule out deploying ICE or CBP to polling places in November?

Noem: There are no plans.

Coons: Will you rule it out?

Noem: *dodges*

Coons: You may be unfamiliar with the federal statute.

Noem: *dodges*

Coons: Will you issue a directive?

Noem: *dodges*

194.title: Kristi Noem REFUSES to Apologize to Alex Pretti's Parents
194.description:
Sen. KLOBUCHAR: Anything you want to say to Alex Pretti’s parents?

Noem: *dodges*

Klobuchar: I asked if you have anything to say to the parents, after you called their son a domestic terrorist without evidence.

Noem, lying: I didn’t.

Klobuchar: They saw it for what it was.

195.title: Republican Senator SLAMS Kristi Noem's Use of Taxpayer Dollars on DHS Ads
195.description:
Even REPUBLICAN Senators are concerned about Kristi Noem wasting taxpayer dollars on her anti-immigrant ad campaign.

Republican Sen. KENNEDY: It troubles me you spent almost A QUARTER BILLION DOLLARS of taxpayer money on ads made by your former spokesperson’s spouse.

196.title: Sen. WHITEHOUSE Presses Noem on Luxury Jet Spending
196.description:
Sen. WHITEHOUSE: Your department’s acquisition of luxury private jets was described as the 'world’s worst deal' and an abuse of federal funds. Did Republicans know about this when they passed their 'billionaire’s bill'?

Noem: *dodges*

197.title: Sen. DURBIN Demands Noem Answer for Wrongful DACA Deportations
197.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Your agency arrested 261 DACA holders last year—and deported 86 of them. Why have you deported dozens of DACA holders?

Noem: We follow all laws.

Durbin: Why did you deport them?

Noem: I don’t know the details.

198.title: Sen. DURBIN Presses Noem: "Will You Admit You Were Wrong?"
198.description:
Sen. DURBIN: You think branding victims like Alex Pretti as “domestic terrorists” calms the situation?

Noem: It’s a tragic loss of life.

Durbin: Is it so hard to say you were wrong?

Noem: I strive for facts.

Durbin: When you fail do you admit it? Will you now?

(She did not.)

199.title: Sen. DURBIN Slams DHS Lies about Renee Good, Alex Pretti to Noem
199.description: Sen. DURBIN: Your agents shot and killed Renee Good and Alex Pretti. Two American citizens. While their families struggle with these horrible tragedies, they've had to fight baseless accusations from you, after you falsely claimed they were domestic terrorists.

200.title: Sen. DURBIN Tells Noem Directly: "DHS Lacks a Moral Compass"
200.description: Sen. DURBIN: Madam Secretary, your DHS has operated without any moral compass or respect for rule of law. DHS agents have acted with unspeakable cruelty against children, immigrants, and American citizens.

201.title: Sen. WELCH Corners Trump Nominee on Election Denialism
201.description:
Sen. WELCH: Who won the 2020 election?

Trump nominee: Joe Biden was certified.

Welch: Who won the 2024 election?

Nominee: President Trump was certified.

Welch: You know I know that. Did Joe Biden not win but was certified?

Nominee: *dodges*

202.title: Sen. DURBIN Admonishes Kash Patel for FBI Private Jet Scandal
202.description: Sen. DURBIN: Kash Patel has exploited the FBI’s private jet. Golfing, watching his girlfriend perform, and flying to chug beers with the men’s hockey team. A whistleblower said he told field agents ‘if you have golf, hockey, fishing, hunting, or beautiful sites, you will see a lot of me.’

203.title: Trump Nominee Refuses to Support Longstanding DOJ Ethics Rules
203.description:
WOW.

A Trump nominee REFUSES to answer if handpicked “weaponization” lackeys must abide by longstanding Justice Department ethics rules.

Sen. SCHIFF calls it out. 🔥

204.title: Sen. WELCH Admonishes Trump Nominee for Role in DOJ Weaponization
204.description:
Sen. WELCH: Donald Trump detractors become enemies, and the Justice Department goes after them. There’s no place in our justice system for that. Would you agree?

Trump nominee: *dodges*

Welch: Be specific.

Nominee: There is a list.

Welch: Where?

Nominee: *dodges*

205.title: Sen. HIRONO Corners Trump Nominee on $400 Million Qatari Plane
205.description:
Sen. HIRONO: We have a president who accepted a $400 million plane from Qatar. Does that sound like a bribe or fraud?

Trump nominee, dodging: I follow the facts.

Hirono: Great, that’s what we need. Not someone doing Trump’s bidding.

206.title: Sen. DURBIN Pushes Trump Nominee on Weaponizing DOJ
206.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Do you lead a weaponization working group with Ed Martin, who has already been removed from two DOJ positions?
 
Trump nominee: *dodges*
 
Durbin: So the answer is yes?
 
Nominee: I’m involved.
 
Durbin: You’re tactful in your answer. This effort should come to an end.

207.title: Sen. COONS Knocks Trump Admin for Gutting Real Ways to Fight Fraud
207.description: Sen. COONS: The Trump Administration is less concerned with fighting fraud than it is with targeting people and states it dislikes. They’ve shut down, eliminated, or defunded antifraud units. If Trump were serious, he’d applaud work already done by the previous Administration.

208.title: Sen. DURBIN Calls Out Trump Hypocrisy on Fraud
208.description: Sen. DURBIN: The Trump Administration has systemically dismantled offices responsible for rooting out fraud. They’re teams responsible for prosecuting crypto crime, fraud against consumers, tax fraud, and public corruption. Want to root out fraud? Start at the top of the Administration itself.

209.title: Sen. DURBIN Calls Out Trump Lies on Arresting the "Worst of the Worst"
209.description:
Sen. DURBIN: Donald Trump told us he’s going after the ‘worst of the worst’ with immigration enforcement. How are they doing on that score?

Immigration expert: Just 5 percent had violent criminal convictions of any kind.

Durbin: 1 out of 20.

210.title: Sen. DURBIN Condemns Republicans Wasting Time on Anti-Immigrant Agenda
210.description: Sen. DURBIN: It’s our responsibility to conduct oversight of the Trump Administration. Instead, we’re having our second hearing in two weeks demonizing an entire community based on a few individuals’ misconduct.

211.title: Sen. KLOBUCHAR Calls Out DOJ for Stopping Fraud Invstigations
211.description: Sen. KLOBUCHAR: As a person who actually called the Justice Department to ask for more resources for our U.S. Attorney’s office, I think the saddest thing—besides the 3,000 ICE agents on the streets—is the loss of 14 Assistant U.S. Attorneys taking on these fraud cases.

212.title: Sen. PADILLA Blasts Republicans' Shameful Anti-Immigrant Playbook
212.description: Sen. PADILLA: What’s this hearing *really* about? It’s about Republicans choosing to point to a few isolated incidents and using them to cast suspicion on entire immigrant communities. It’s an old, shameful playbook

213.title: Sen. WHITEHOUSE Calls Out Republicans' Sham Fraud Hearing
213.description:
Sen. WHITEHOUSE calls out Senate Judiciary Republicans’ sham hearing on “fighting fraud.”

“What a strange thing it is to have a hearing about Minnesota that doesn’t address what’s on the front pages of every newspaper about Minnesota.”

🔥🔥🔥

214.title: Sen. HIRONO Blasts Trump Fraud During Republican Hearing
214.description: Sen. HIRONO: This is a hearing about fraud. There are so many examples in the Trump Administration. A $400 million jet from Qatar. Kash Patel and Kristi Noem using taxpayer funded private jets for personal travel. Billionaires with special access.

215.title: Sen. DURBIN Calls Out Republican Hypocrisy on 'Fraud' Smears
215.description: Sen. DURBIN: Fraud is a crime. It should be prosecuted. The Biden Justice Department opened the Minnesota fraud investigation and brought the first prosecution. The Trump Justice Department diverted agents away from fraud investigation to focus on mass deportations.

216.title: Sen. WHITEHOUSE Reminds Republicans' of Their OWN WORDS re: January 6th
216.description: Sen. WHITEHOUSE: Let me reject the notion that the Justice Department’s investigation into the attack on the Capitol was worse than the attack on the Capitol. There’s a real then and now problem. Trump subservience now requires amnesia.

217.title: Sen. SCHIFF Calls for Republicans to Bring in Jack Smith
217.description: Sen. SCHIFF: This committee has the power to subpoena Volume II of the Special Counsel’s report. This committee has the power to bring Jack Smith in to testify. Instead of badgering all of you, we could go right to the source.

218.title: Sen. KLOBUCHAR Debunks MAGA Lies About January 6th Law Enforcement
218.description:
Sen. KLOBUCHAR: How would you respond to Donald Trump and his allies who claim the work of law enforcement was a ‘diabolical weaponization’?

Former January 6th prosecutor: It’s slanderous. It’s offensive. We’re committed public servants who worked to protect lives.

219.title: Sen. DURBIN Calls Out Republicans Delaying Jack Smith Testimony
219.description: Sen. DURBIN: Jack Smith is not hiding. He is not avoiding testimony under oath. Jack Smith volunteered to come before our committee, but the Chairman didn’t take advantage of it. All Republicans need to do is push the open door.

220.title: Sen. WHITEHOUSE Blasts Nominee for Ties to Koch Brothers, Leonard Leo
220.description:
Sen. WHITEHOUSE: Every one of your employers has been funded by the Koch Brothers or Leonard Leo. How will you deal with cases they have an interest in?
 
Trump nominee: *dodges*
 
Whitehouse: *lists all connections to Koch Brothers or Leonard Leo*

221.title: Sen. SCHIFF Calls Out Gutting DOJ Resources for Immigration Raids
221.description: Sen. SCHIFF to Trump ATF nominee: It’s pretty incontestable. If you need more agents, then diverting agents for immigration enforcement will dilute your effectiveness.

222.title: Sen. BOOKER Calls Out Gutting ATF for Immigration Enforcement
222.description:
Sen. BOOKER: How many agents are conducting immigration enforcement?
 
Trump ATF nominee: 100 at any time.
 
Booker: Has that impacted enforcing gun laws?
 
Nominee: *MAGA talking points*
 
Booker: That’s hard for me to believe.

223.title: Sen. DURBIN Warns Judicial Nominees to Put the Law First
223.description: Sen. DURBIN: It’s not an easy time to be a judge, but it’s more important than ever in our history. So, I hope today’s nominees can persuade us that if you are confirmed, you will be loyal to the rule of law—not the President.

224.title: Sen. BOOKER Pushes Netflix CEO on Merger Concerns
224.description:
Sen. BOOKER: Why’s there such a universal fear from the industry about this merger?
 
Netflix CEO: Anytime there is change, they get nervous. I gave my testimony under oath.
 
Booker: And I’ve seen more companies come here and give promises without following them.

225.title: Sen. KLOBUCHAR Shares Antitrust Concerns on Netflix-Warner Bros. Merger
225.description: Sen. KLOBUCHAR: I’ve had longtime concerns about competition. Any time the biggest player seeks to get bigger, there’s concern for consumers. Netflix is the most popular streaming service. It would take over HBO Max and have power to further increase prices.

226.title: Sen. WELCH Defends Creatives During Netflix-Warner Bros. Merger
226.description:
Sen. WELCH: The Writers Guild says after the Warner Bros.-Discovery merger, the merged firm canceled $2 billion in content. Is that true?

Warner Bros. executive: Yes.

Welch: This is the key question. We need more content, not less. There are fewer buyers and less competition.

227.title: Sen. BOOKER Calls Out Paramount CEO for Refusing to Testify
227.description: Sen. BOOKER: There’s an absence here—Paramount. The sale of Warner Bros. to any competitor could have serious consequences. I invited David Ellison to appear. He declined, saying it ‘would not be useful.’

228.title: Rabbi Says Bipartisanship Honors the Premise of "Never Again"
228.description:
Jewish rabbi: I’m not a lawyer, I’m only a rabbi.
 
Sen. DURBIN, lightheartedly: In the hierarchy of things, you don’t need to apologize for that.
 
Jewish rabbi: But I think it’s important to remember why we’re here. Bipartisanship can finally get to the truth.

229.title: Jewish Rabbi Issues Stern Warning on Spiking Antisemitism
229.description: Jewish rabbi: We’re living in a dangerous period. Antisemitism is rising at levels not seen in generations. Since October 7, 2023, there’s a surge in hatred and denial. Moral clarity erodes when truth becomes negotiable.

230.title: Trump Says Republicans Should "Take Over the Voting"
230.description:
Will any elected Republican call this out and stand up to these continued attacks on our democracy?

This is how our democracy dies.

231.title: Sen. HIRONO Calls for Protection of Privacy in 702 Reform
231.description: Sen. HIRONO: There’s a compelling Section 702 compromise to protect privacy. You can conduct queries to see if there are results, but if you want to view the contents, you need a warrant. You can look at the outside of the envelope, but you need a warrant to open it.

232.title: Sen. SCHIFF Highlights Glaring Loophole in Surveillance Law
232.description:
Sen. SCHIFF: We prohibited disclosing or selling of customer data to government agencies—but it doesn’t cover third party data brokers. Should we allow the government to get info by buying it without a warrant?

Privacy and civil liberties expert: It’s a loophole.

233.title: Sen. DURBIN Defends Fourth Amendment Amid Trump Admin Actions
233.description: Sen. DURBIN: Situations in Chicago and Minneapolis have led to helicopters landing on apartment buildings, people crashing down front doors of homes without a warrant. Americans don’t care for that. It’s a question of privacy.

234.title: Sen. COONS Blasts Trump Officials for Not Appearing at Hearing
234.description: Sen. COONS: I’d hoped to hear from witnesses on Section 702 reforms and implementation today, but I can’t ask those questions of government officials—because they’re not here. Section 702 expires in three months, and the Trump Administration has no official position. Stunning.

235.title: Sen. WELCH Calls Out Kash Patel for Closing Accountability Office
235.description:
Sen. WELCH: Kash Patel shuttered the office responsible for overseeing government compliance with surveillance rules. What’s that do to public confidence in Section 702?
 
Privacy and civil liberties expert: It’s a real concern. We don’t have data on implementation in 2025.

236.title: Privacy, Civil Liberties Expert Testifies on Sec. 702 Reform
236.description: Privacy and civil liberties expert: Even if there were ‘only’ 5,000 warrantless searches of Americans communications—that’s 5,000 too many. It’s an invitation to governmental overreach and abuse under any administration. Congress must now do what it should’ve done years ago.

237.title: Sen. DURBIN Calls Out Secretary Noem for Delayed Testimony
237.description: Sen. DURBIN: I’ve been calling for Secretary Noem to testify for months. She has ‘such a busy schedule’ that she failed to appear last year. She now says she will appear in five weeks. What’s going to happen in Minneapolis in the next five weeks?

238.title: Sen. DURBIN Blasts Trump Admin for Failing to Send Witnesses
238.description: Sen. DURBIN: Section 702 of FISA will expire in three months. I’m disappointed we don’t have any Trump Administration witnesses testifying. We must be able to publicly question officials on this sweeping authority. The failure of officials to appear is troubling.

239.title: Durbin Against the Nominations of Emil Bove to Serve a Lifetime Position on the Federal Bench

240.title: Durbin: Trust the American People, Tell Them the Truth About the Epstein Files

241.title: Defending the Rights of the People: Allies Fight Back Against Trump’s Constitutional Abuses
241.description:
Donald Trump and his administration have continued to violate the Constitution.
 
Watch to see how states’ Attorneys General are fighting to protect our Constitution and hold this Administration accountable.

242.title: Cruel and Unamerican: The Abuse of Immigrants to Attack our Constitutional Order
242.description:
Donald Trump’s anti-immigrant agenda is NOT what America stands for.
 
Eliminating due process. Arresting noncriminals. Disappearing people to a brutal foreign prison.
 
Watch as we call out this abuse of immigrants that attacks our constitutional order.

243.title: Durbin Questions Witnesses During Spotlight Hearing on the Trump Admin's Attack on the Rule of Law

244.title: Former DOJ Civil Rights Attorney Sounds ALARM on Attacks Against DOJ Workforce
244.description:
Former DOJ civil rights attorney: The attacks on the Department’s workforce are too widespread and numerous to catalog in a single hearing.

“Congress should be deeply concerned.”

245.title: Former Skadden Associate Who RESIGNED on Courage Amid Attacks on Rule of Law
245.description:
Former Skadden associate: The Administration cannot pick and choose who gets representation. It cannot use executive power to scare lawyers out of advocacy.

“I will not allow my fear to manifest as silence. I choose courage.”

246.title: Former DOJ Public Integrity Attorney on Trump THREATS Against Legal Community
246.description:
Former DOJ public integrity attorney: The threats against current members of the legal community are real, and they’re of consequence.

“Every attorney who takes an oath to uphold the law… must have a line in the sand that cannot be crossed.”

247.title: Former DOJ Pardon Attorney Shares CALLOUS CRUELTY of DOJ Leadership
247.description:
Former DOJ pardon attorney: I was terminated from my job exactly one month ago as the Justice Department’s pardon attorney, a nonpolitical position.

“I was in shock… everyone I passed on the way out was looking on in shock and horror.”

248.title: Durbin Reflects on the Confirmation of Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson

249.title: Donald Trump's UNPRECEDENTED Attacks on Lawyers, Rule of Law
249.description:
Sen. DURBIN at rule of law spotlight hearing: The attacks on lawyers and the rule of law are unprecedented, and we can’t allow them to continue.

“This is the kind of thing we expect from tin-pot dictatorships in other parts of the world.”

250.title: Republicans Say NOTHING as Trump Administration Attacks Rule of Law
250.description:
Rep. RASKIN at rule of law spotlight hearing: Our witnesses have refused to bow down in the way so many of our colleagues have been complicit.

In every attack against the rule of law… “Republicans say nothing.”

251.title: The Rule of Law is Being ATTACKED by an Administration "Intoxicated by Its Own Power"
251.description:
Sen. SCHIFF at rule of law spotlight hearing: We’re here today because democracy is under attack… not by a foreign adversary or some distant threat, but from within.

“From an Administration intoxicated by its own power and enabled by a supine Congress.”

252.title: Three Years of JUSTICE Ketanji Brown Jackson
252.description: April 7, 2022. The Senate confirmed JUSTICE Ketanji Brown Jackson.
